title: browser-security-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.oauth.popup-complete, identity.openapi.document; exact inputs: origin, csrf_token, callback_state, cookie_attributes; initial state: trusted origin and bound browser state are configured

stimulus.const: Run identity.oauth.popup-complete then identity.openapi.document for success, failure, denial cases using origin, csrf_token, callback_state, cookie_attributes and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: every HTTP operation is independently checked against its exact method, path, access, cookie and CSRF or origin policy; trusted callbacks succeed while untrusted origins, missing CSRF, ambient-cookie substitution and insecure cookie variants are rejected; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: trusted_origin_count, csrf_rejected, origin_rejected, secure_cookie_observed, same_site_mode, operation_security_results

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: every HTTP operation is independently checked against its exact method, path, access, cookie and CSRF or origin policy; trusted callbacks succeed while untrusted origins, missing CSRF, ambient-cookie substitution and insecure cookie variants are rejected; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: trusted_origin_count, csrf_rejected, origin_rejected, secure_cookie_observed, same_site_mode, operation_security_results

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/browser-security-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/browser-security-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
